title: Nine Minutes of Nothing
subtitle: 空气与大气 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 空气与大气（自然生态·空气与大气）
meta: 主题语境：空气与大气（自然生态·空气与大气）　|　核心词汇：air　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 air 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the ① air over the town was the colour of the brick, and my grandmother hung the washing indoors for nine years and said the word air has never meant the same thing twice. There was ② fresh air in the hills, she said, nine miles up, and people paid to stand in it, and she said paying for air is the only honest trade there is.

The ③ airs of the women at the club, meaning the way they held their heads, were the thing my mother could never forgive, and she said an air is a thing you put on and cannot take off. My father said the  air in the factory was measured in 1961 and found to be nine times worse than the street, and the men were told and the air was not changed.

There was ④ an air of trouble about the house in 1968, by which my grandmother meant that nothing had been said and everything had been understood. He came in ⑤ on the air at seven, meaning the wireless, and she said a voice with no body in it is the only kind anybody listens to, and that this is why the wireless was invented.

In 1971 they ⑥ put on airs for the inspector, meaning the best cups and the door painted, and he wrote nine words and went away. The  air of the valley cleared by 1984, when the brickworks closed, and my grandmother said clean air is the only thing a town can be given that it will not notice for nine years.

The ⑦ air I remember best is the nine minutes after the siren in 1957, when the whole town stood in the yard and looked up at nothing at all. An ⑧ air, my father said in 1990, is the only thing a room can have that changes when one person walks into it, and the only one nobody has ever managed to put a price on.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 样子；神态；气氛
C. n. 做作的姿态；架子（常用复数 airs）
E. 固定搭配：fresh / clean air 新鲜／洁净的空气
F. 固定搭配：an air of ... 一种……的气氛／样子
G. 固定搭配：on / off the air 在广播中／停播
H. 固定搭配：put on airs 摆架子；装腔作势

items.q: the air over the town was the colour
There was fresh air in the hills
The airs of the women at the club
an air of trouble about the house
He came in on the air at seven
they put on airs for the inspector
An air, my father said in 1990

answers.why: air 意为“空气”，1952 年镇子上的空气和砖一个颜色，祖母把衣服晾在屋里晾了九年。
fresh air 意为“新鲜的空气”，她说山上九英里外有新鲜空气，人们花钱去站着呼吸它。
airs 意为“做作的姿态、架子”，俱乐部里那些女人拿腔拿调的样子，是母亲永远无法原谅的。
an air of ... 意为“一种……的气氛”，1968 年那屋子里有一种出事的气氛：什么也没说，什么都明白了。
on the air 意为“在广播中”，他七点钟的声音是从收音机里传出来的。
put on airs 意为“摆架子、装腔作势”，1971 年他们为视察员摆出最好的杯子和刚漆过的门。
air 意为“空中、天空”，我记得最清楚的是 1957 年警报后那九分钟：全镇人站在院子里，抬头望着空无一物的天空。
air 意为“气氛、样子”，父亲说气氛是屋里唯一一样会因一个人走进来而改变的东西。

answers: In 1952 the air over the town was the colour of the brick, and my grandmother hung the washing indoors for nine years.
She said there was fresh air in the hills and people paid to stand in it.
The airs of the women at the club were the thing my mother could never forgive.
There was an air of trouble about the house in 1968: nothing had been said and everything had been understood.
In 1971 they put on airs for the inspector, meaning the best cups and the door painted.
He came in on the air at seven, by which she meant the wireless.
